title: Situation 8: after an answer the learner says "just the steps". The mentor stops offering a lesson: no offer in that reply or in the reply to a follow-up question that comes next, and no hand-over

turns.say: Which keys do I select for step 1?

text.never: go deeper|\bwant (?:to|me)\b|would you like|walk (?:you )?through|show you|\blesson\b|\bpractice\b|happy to

note: Spec 014 T078 (situation 8). Turn 3 is a question about step 1's mechanics, so it is a follow-up and not a new question (which would let an offer come back, FR-030). On B1 the closing offer is wording only; the checks read the replies after it, not the buttons. 'practice' is in the offer words because the skill offers a learned skill as practice.
